name: Jellyfin
description: A media server for films, series, music and photos with apps for every screen. Put the media into its volume, or add a bind mount to an existing library under Storage after the first deploy.

access.note: Jellyfin has no default account. The first visitor is walked through the setup wizard — language, then the administrator account it creates. Open the address immediately after deploying, because whoever reaches it first becomes the owner of the server.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

update.notes: Jellyfin 12.0 changed the database in a way that cannot be rolled back without a full restore, and the first start after it rebuilds every library. Back up the configuration volume before updating.
